integrity.proof_basis: Direct point-map computation, a compactly supported norming function, and an explicit club construction.

scientific_limitations: The claim classifies pairwise commutators within the canonical ordinal-club projection family only.
It does not classify the full algebra generated by the family or commutators with arbitrary operators.
The literature comparison is targeted, not exhaustive.
title: Commutator dichotomy and commuting antichains of ordinal-club projections
